$comment: The unique Flux illustrations for Book 1. Activities 27 and 35 reuse earlier art. Level 5's cut-and-glue pieces are not here at all: Flux returns a whole vehicle whenever a vehicle part is named, and independently generated pieces would not fit together when glued, so scripts/pieces.py draws them. The shared style block lives in style.txt and is prepended at generate time so it can never drift.
